title: Election Commission of India extends the SIR dates in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya
body_text:
A meeting of the Election Commission of India was held today at 4.30 PM at Nirvachan Sadan, New Delhi. The meeting was attended by Chief Election Commissioner Shri Gyanesh Kumar and Election Commissioners Dr. SS Sandhu and Dr. Vivek Joshi. During the meeting it was decided to extend the SIR dates in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya. The revised schedule is as under:
State Notice Phase/disposal of claims and objection Final publication Andhra Pradesh 31.07.2026 to 10.10.2026 16.10.2026 Meghalaya - 26.10.2026
**********
